# `audit_event`

Tamper-evident audit trail (AUD-01..AUD-09). Per-tenant hash chain; append-only for every role.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | append-only-log |
| Tenant scope | Tenant scoped: `tenant_id` + row-level security, composite keys/FKs |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `occurred_at`, `recorded_at` |
| Retention class | `audit-trail`: Per audit category within legal minimums, with legal hold (AUD-07). Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | /v1/audit-events (planned, audit_event:view) |
| Write path | writeAudit() inside the business transaction; provision_tenant(). |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0001_foundation (expand). Never contract: removing columns would break hash verification of existing rows; add a new hash version instead. |

## Constraints

- PK (tenant_id, seq)
- unique (tenant_id, id)
- seq gapless per tenant
- prev_hash = previous row hash; hash = sha256(prev_hash | canonical row)
- seq, prev_hash, hash, recorded_at, txid assigned by trigger
- UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE rejected for every role
- category, actor_type, result, source from fixed lists
